pages.text: $(italic)Antique Atlas$() — the hand-drawn explorer's map. In Novus it's bound to you and opens with $(bold)M$() (no item needed), but you can carry a $(bold)physical copy$() if you want a separate map per base or dimension.$(br2)The full walkthrough is in $(l:4_wayfaring/atlas)Wayfaring & Maps$().$(br2)$(bold)To make the item:$() take a $(italic)Book$() to an $(italic)Anvil$() and rename it $(bold)Antique Atlas$(), exactly so.
pages.title: Antique Atlas
